title: Deficiency Balance Accounts: Idle-Account Points on Installment Settlements
content:
**Rule.** The premium idle days of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts are the calendar days from the later of its opening date and its latest payment date (the date of the latest posted payment that was not returned) to today, counted from the opening date when there is no latest payment date. 90 or more idle days add 3.0 surcharge points to an installment settlement, at least 30 but fewer than 90 add 1.5 points, and fewer add no points. The points are percentage points of the balance.

| Premium idle days | Surcharge points |
|---|---|
| 90 or more | 3.0 |
| 30 to 89 | 1.5 |
| 0 to 29 | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Latest payment date 30 calendar days before today: 1.5 points; 29 days: none.
- Latest payment date 90 calendar days before today: 3.0 points; 89 days: 1.5 points.
- An account opened 100 calendar days ago with no payment ever posted: counted from the opening date, 100 idle days, 3.0 points.
- An account opened 200 days ago whose latest payment that was not returned posted 40 days ago: 40 idle days, 1.5 points. A payment that was returned does not move the latest payment date.
